meta.name: reasoning-mixer-model-picker
meta.description: Dark cockpit-style AI model picker popover: three model rows (Sol/Terra/Luna) as horizontal 5-stop reasoning-effort sliders inside a recessed speckled well, plus a vertical ULTRA thermometer lever whose red ball drops, ignites violet, fills the tube and showers confetti dashes. Anchored above a chat input bar whose label live-updates.
source_references: Video from Twitter.mp4 — 752 frames @60fps, 1794x1120; keyframe sprite sheets at 2fps + 12/15/24fps dense extractions around open, row-switch, ULTRA on/off transitions; full-res crops with pixel sampling

color.palette_type: triadic saturated accents (orange/green/violet) on a near-black monochrome base

primary.role: ULTRA mode identity — overrides any active row fill, stem, bulb, label glow, panel aura

secondary.role: Sol model fill + active label; Terra uses #5FE893, Luna uses #8B5CF6 (per-row identities)

accent.role: resting ULTRA lever ball — glossy red sphere begging to be pulled

neutral.usage: page → panel → trough/pill → grid well → dots → tier text → column headers → inactive model labels → thumb

color.contrast_strategy: layered low-luminance greys separated by 1 step each; all emphasis carried by saturated fills and glow, text stays grey-on-grey until a row activates

typography.font_style_notes: pure SF Pro system stack, antialiased; overline (ULTRA) is bold uppercase heavily letterspaced; model names read one weight heavier than tier words

spacing.content_density: compact-comfortable — control rows breathe but panel wastes nothing
spacing.section_rhythm: single surface; grid and lever share one vertical band, input bar sits 10px below panel

layout.grid_system: label column + 5 equal stop-columns; lever column appended right
layout.gutter: 0 (stops butt together; hit areas are whole cells)
layout.breakpoints: single-size component; scales down proportionally under 680px
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid for stops; popover center-anchored above trigger pill

shape.border_usage: hairline rgba(255,255,255,.06) on panel; violet 1px outline materializes on lever card + panel in ULTRA
shape.divider_style: none — grouping via recessed wells (common-region), not lines

elevation.shadow_style: layered soft black ambience + recessed inner shadows; glow replaces shadow as the elevation cue in ULTRA
elevation.depth_cues: recessed wells (neumorphic-dark), glossy sphere speculars, ambient-occlusion halo around thumb, violet aura in ULTRA

iconography.style: filled minimal glyphs (lightning), 1.8px stroke outlines (mic, arrows, chevron)

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) for surfaces; spring linear() with ~4% overshoot for thumb/fill; gravity ease-in with landing bounce for the lever ball

duration_scale.normal: 250-280ms (fill growth, thumb, panel open, ball drop)
duration_scale.macro: 420ms (glow bloom, confetti burst, panel pulse — system feedback after landing)

motion.entrance_pattern: popover scales from the trigger (bottom-center origin) while the active fill pours in from zero
motion.exit_pattern: quick 150ms fade-scale; deactivating fills collapse leftward and fade simultaneously
motion.philosophy: tactile hardware playfulness — controls behave like physical toys (springs, gravity, ignition), but every user-initiated move settles within 300ms

components.input_style: pill trigger inside a rounded bar; label = bolt + semibold name + grey tier + chevron
components.card_style: recessed speckled wells sunk into the panel (inset shadow + noise dots)
components.modal_style: anchored popover, origin-aware growth from trigger, no backdrop dim (context stays visible)
components.list_style: rows ARE sliders: label + 5-dot track, fill capsule to selected stop, white thumb riding the leading edge
components.component_notes: one model active at a time (2D radio: model x effort); dots keep #515151 even over fills; hovered dot ignites in its row color at 1.5x; ULTRA lever = vertical trough + silver track, red ball rests on top; engaging drops ball to bulb position, track above becomes glowing violet stem

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: audio mixing console crossed with a pinball plunger / thermometer
aesthetic.era_influence: 2024+ dark consumer-AI UI with tasteful skeuomorphic regression (glossy spheres, recessed hardware wells)

visual_language.complexity: moderate — one dense control cluster, zero chrome elsewhere
visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents: speckle noise on wells, sparkle particles and confetti dashes reserved for ULTRA
visual_language.whitespace_usage: tight inside the panel, generous void around it
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy left grid balanced by a single saturated lever right
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element — the one saturated fill; ULTRA activation is the deliberate crescendo
visual_language.contrast_level: extreme hue contrast on near-flat luminance base
visual_language.texture_usage: sparse dark speckle dots on wells and trough (hardware plastic feel)

composition.hierarchy_method: color weight — the only saturated element is the current choice
composition.balance_type: asymmetric: wide grid vs narrow lever
composition.flow_direction: left-to-right effort crescendo, ending at the vertical ULTRA exclamation
composition.grouping_strategy: common-region wells group stops; lever isolated in its own card
composition.negative_space_role: void isolates the popover; inactive rows read as negative space until hovered

imagery.graphic_elements: glossy spheres (specular top-left), capsule fills, glowing stem, dash confetti
imagery.pattern_usage: random speckle dot noise at ~3% white / 25% black

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate color ignition + spring settle; celebration reserved for ULTRA (glow bloom, confetti, panel pulse)
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: dots ignite in their row color and scale 1.5x; lever ball shows grab cursor
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy with spring overshoot; gravity for the ball drop
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: high inside the component, silent outside it

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: subtle suggestion — the red ball is the CTA by pure appearance

overview.fallback_strategy: prefers-reduced-motion: instant state switches, particles hidden, glows become static
overview.primary_technology: CSS transitions/keyframes + linear() springs + DOM particle spans seeded by vanilla JS

background_effects.description: static sparse speckle dots embossed on wells and trough (dark dots + faint light dots)

particle_systems.type: custom — (a) white twinkle sparkles in and just outside ULTRA fills, (b) FOUR dashed zigzag energy rails flanking the thermometer groove (upper pair at 20-42% of card height, lower pair hugging the bulb at 73-91%)
particle_systems.description: sparkles: 1.2-3.4px white dots (every 3rd softly blurred) twinkling with slight drift, in and past the active fill's edges; rails: fixed vertical zigzag paths (amplitude ~8% of card width, bend every ~8px, 4 legs ≈ 38px) drawn twice — a very faint full-path ghost plus a bright 4.5/4.5 dash pattern MARCHING continuously down the path (~280ms per period, per-rail 260-320ms + negative delays to desync); dashes crossing bends read as ‹ › corners — frame-by-frame traced from the source video
particle_systems.technology: sparkles: absolutely-positioned spans + CSS keyframes; rails: inline SVG polyline pairs (ghost + runner), pathLength=38 keeps dash units ≈ px, runner stroke-dasharray 4.5 4.5 with stroke-dashoffset 9 → 0 linear infinite (one period per lap = seamless march); JS only seeds geometry once

params.count: 11 sparkles per fill, 12 tick groups (17 chevrons with doubles)
params.shape: circle / chevron polyline pointing outward from the groove
params.movement_pattern: sparkles twinkle in place; chevrons draw in from inner vertex, hold, then travel out along their own path
params.color_behavior: sparkles white @ 40-95% alpha; chevrons #8D67EC / #A283F4 / #BFA6F9 rotating by nth-child
params.spawn_area: fill capsule ±6px vertical overflow; gutters between the ball groove and the lever-card edge

3d_elements.description: spheres are faked with radial gradients

text_effects.description: input-bar label exits up with 2px blur and the new model+tier enters from below on every committed change; instant (no animation) while dragging across stops

cursor_effects.description: native cursors only: pointer on cells, grab/grabbing on ball

params.border_treatment: hairline light-alpha; violet outline materializes in ULTRA
params.shadow_type: recessed inset wells + layered black drop on popover + violet glow aura in ULTRA

svg_animations.description: four dashed zigzag rails around the thermometer: faint static full-path ghosts with a bright dash pattern marching continuously along each path while ULTRA is engaged; trigger chevron icon flips via CSS transform

params.animation_method: CSS keyframes on stroke-dashoffset, linear infinite (continuous flow, ~280ms per dash period)
params.stroke_animation: runner dasharray 4.5 4.5 on pathLength 38, dashoffset 9 → 0 per lap; 1.2px strokes, round caps/joins

visual_effects.composite_notes: Thermometer anatomy is TWO nested capsules: the speckled lever card, and a recessed near-black groove (~ball width - 4px) sunk into it — ball, silver track, and stem all travel inside the groove; the ULTRA outline is a crisp 1px violet stroke around the card, not a haze. ULTRA activation choreography (the crescendo): (1) t0 ball releases past 55% travel or is clicked — instantly recolors red→violet and accelerates down under gravity easing ~220ms, the silver track above it progressively igniting into a glowing violet stem; (2) on landing the ball swells subtly (~1.06x) into the bulb, glow blooms over ~420ms with a 40ms breath; (3) confetti dashes burst radially with 0-160ms stagger, ULTRA overline ignites violet with text-shadow, lever card and panel gain violet 1px outline + aura, and the panel does one 1.014 scale pulse ~300ms; (4) active row fill cross-fades to violet with white sparkles twinkling; sparkles/confetti keep twinkling ambiently while engaged. Deactivation reverses in ~200ms without celebration: ball springs back to top recoloring to red, stem drains, sparkles/outline/aura fade, row fill returns to its model color. Row switching: outgoing fill collapses leftward + fades in 150ms ease-in while incoming fill springs out to its stop in 260ms — both rows never show full fills simultaneously. Popover open pours the active fill from zero after the 250ms bottom-center scale-in.
